column3: Every startup has two questions it can't answer cheaply. What are we worth? And who exactly owns us? A proper valuation takes weeks and costs thousands, and the cap table lives in a spreadsheet. BlockID Startup Passport answers both. Agents propose. Humans approve. Chains prove.

Today, early valuations are slow, costly and unsourced, and shareholders can't verify what they own. With BlockID, a founder pastes a website and gets an evidence-cited valuation in minutes. After one human approval, they have KYC-gated shares on-chain, a cap table they can grow, and dividends they can pay, all verifiable by anyone.

Here is the whole system on one slide. The founder gives a website and a shareholder list. AI agents read up to six pages and run three searches, and a fixed formula computes the value. The agents hold no keys. A human admin signs one approval. Only then does the isolated issuer, the only component with a key, create the register on our zero-gas chain and mirror it to Ethereum and HashKey. The proof: tokens in MetaMask, a verify page, and a public explorer.

The AI only suggests scores. It reads the company's public site, finds competitors and analyses the market, and every claim must cite a fetched source, or it is dropped. A fixed, public formula then turns seven weighted dimensions into a grade and a valuation range. For Airwallex, it found eight real competitors, and graded it C.

Then, one approval. The isolated issuer creates the share register on our zero-gas BlockID chain: an identity registry, KYC for every holder, and the shares themselves. It then mirrors the register, with a Merkle root, to Ethereum Hoodi and HashKey Chain. The founder watches every step live, and shareholders add the token to MetaMask on any chain.

You don't have to trust us. The verify page recomputes the valuation report hash right in your browser, and compares it with the hash anchored on all three chains. No login needed. Change a single score, and it turns red.

This is live today: twelve real companies, thirty-six token contracts on three chains, and sixty-nine point eight billion Australian dollars of indicative valuation on-chain, with every hash verified. Our customers are founders and SMEs in Australia and Vietnam, accelerators, and licensed intermediaries who issue and administer startup equity. Scan the code and try it at eth dot blockid dot a u. We're looking for pilot startups and licensed partners. Thank you.
